Name: ReverseSpline
Description: This will create a ReverseSpline System

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create a ReverseSpline System.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.

Create Step:
- After creating the block, you will be prompted for the amount of joints.
- This block enforces odd values only (5, 7, 9, 11, ...).
- Maximum supported amount is 25 joints.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
